# POICard

POICard is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { POICard } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Components
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-poicard--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  NavigationPointer01 as Navigation,
  Share01 as Share2,
  Star01 as Star,
} from "@kozmos-ds/icons";
import { Badge, Button, POICard, Tag, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function POICardExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <POICard
        title="Starbucks Coffee"
        subtitle="Floor 1 • Terminal A"
        className="w-[380px] max-w-full"
        description="Cozy Seattle-based coffeehouse chain known for its signature roasts, light bites, and free WiFi availability."
        badges={
          <>
            <Tag emotion="success">Open Now</Tag>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Café</Badge>
          </>
        }
        actions={
          <>
            <Button className="flex-1" size="sm">
              <Navigation className="w-4 h-4" /> Navigate
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" aria-label="Share location">
              <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" aria-label="Save location">
              <Star className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## POICard

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `POICardProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onClick">`.

- `imageUrl`: `string`, optional.
- `imageAlt`: `string`, optional, default `title`.
- `title`: `string`, **required**.
- `subtitle`: `string`, optional.
- `description`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `badges`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `actions`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `onClick`: `React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>`, optional.
- `selectionLabel`: `string`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
